entity.name: Efe Baran Durmaz
entity.description: Independent open-source maintainer building governance infrastructure for autonomous agents: policy checks, human approvals, revocation, and tamper-evident audit evidence before consequential actions (local execution and financial authority). Based in Ankara, Turkey; maintains Sardis and Agentbox.

projects.name: Agentbox
projects.description: Local-first governed runtime for autonomous agents. Intercepts risky host actions (shell, network, credentials, filesystem), routes them through deterministic policy and out-of-band approval, and records auditable execution evidence. Provides an AgentPod contract so agents can run task-scoped cells without unsupervised access to the real machine.

projects.name: Sardis
projects.description: Open-source financial authority layer for AI agents. Enforces signed mandates, deterministic spend policy, approvals, revocation, and audit packets before any wallet, card, stablecoin, payment API, or x402 endpoint moves money. Ships MIT-licensed SDKs (Python/TypeScript), an MCP server, and framework adapters so agents can request spend under human-defined bounds.
